summary: IonQ filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of 20,500,000 common shares and 29,500,000 pre-funded warrants, each bundled with two Series C warrants, at a combined $40.00 per share or per pre-funded warrant. Series C warrants strike at $69.46 and expire seven years out; pre-funded warrants carry a $0.0001 exercise price. Gross proceeds total roughly $2.0 billion before $10 million underwriting discounts, with J.P. Morgan as sole underwriter. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing versus the $34.73 reference close and warrant overhang.
